prompt: Gray counts stars from the rooftop
title: Rooftop Stars
irony: Gray plans to count every star exactly, but the sky keeps adding more stars than her chart can hold, so she stops counting and dances with the kids under too many stars to count.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blankets cover the big house rooftop at night; Gray holds a star chart while Navy and Green gaze at the glittering sky.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Gray plans to count every star exactly; Navy fetches cushions while Green names the bright dots, and Gray's neat list begins.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black climbs up the ladder with a dare: count them all before the moon moves, and no looking away or starting over counts.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew sings the counting chant together, pointing at the sky and spotting red Mars among the stars.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green corrects the count: satellites and planes are not stars, and Gray's numbers tangle as she erases and recounts.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Everyone shouts a different number at once, blankets tangle, the chart flutters off, and they count a blinking firefly by mistake.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: They sing the counting chant again, louder, waving the lost chart like a flag under the wheeling sky.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray admits her charts cannot hold the sky, and she misses the night while guarding the numbers.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray folds the chart into a paper boat, chooses the dance over the count, and invites the sleepy kids to twirl.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They sing the chant once more, and Gray turns the last line: the stars are too many to count, so they dance.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Rooftop stars above them, blankets cover the rooftop again, and the counters doze off dreaming dances under the uncounted sky.
